A group of tumbling '''asteroids''' was situated in the [[Pindra system/Legends|Pindra system]],<ref name="EGTW" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], as part of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|navy]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Willham Burke]] prepared a trap for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|fleet]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ledre Okins]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Burke had a [[grav trap]] laid among the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] of the Pindra [[Star system/Legends|system]] and tricked Okins into diverting key units of his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] there. The Imperial forces were [[Battle of the Pindra system|ensnared]], and Burke went on to [[Battle of Colla|defeat]] Okins in the [[Colla system/Legends|Colla system]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The asteroids of the Pindra system were mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system, and therefore the asteroids, in grid square N-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
